chunks: "Whoever adopts hair and does not part it, Allah will part it with a saw of fire."

key_terms.الصَّادِقُ: Imam Jaʿfar ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq عليه السلام

ai.seo_question: What did Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام say about not parting one's hair?
ai.summary: This hadith conveys a warning regarding personal grooming and the etiquette of maintaining one's hair. It presents neglect of this practice as blameworthy and describes a punishment in the Hereafter in severe terms.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.328 - Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) said:
"Whoever grows their hair and does not part it, Allah (swt) will part it with a saw of fire."
